notes: Summary: SMB inbound lead focused on Hosted API (self-serve). Primary goal: replace current agent backend with lightweight LLM-driven support agent that can call internal tools (ticket lookup, escalate, set status) with structured JSON outputs.
Current pain: streaming mode returns malformed JSON intermittently - missing closing brace or extra trailing commas when tool-calling enabled. Breaks incremental JSON parsers on client.
"We get valid JSON 80% of the time, but the rest crashes our parser" - Samir (CTO).

Function schema issue: customer expects function call payload to follow their schema: {"action": string, "params": { ticket_id: string, notes: string } }. Model sometimes emits "parameters" instead of "params", or includes unexpected nested arrays. Causes downstream mapping failures.

Reproduction notes from SE: using Redwood hosted_api streaming with python SDK (requests-style stream), sample prompt + function schema attached in Drive. Observed truncation when combined with long context and aggressive batching. Suspect tokenization boundary combined with streaming chunk framing.

Workarounds tried: 1) post-stream re-join + heuristic JSON fix (unsafe), 2) force single response (non-streaming) which avoids truncation but increases latency beyond target, 3) add explicit schema constraints in system message which reduced but did not eliminate mismatches.
Security/compliance: SOC2 desired but not blocking for initial POC. Audit logging required for agent actions. No SSO in POC.

POC scope: 2-week trial - validate streaming reliability and function-calling stability for core ticket workflows (lookup, update, escalate). Goal: <200ms token latency for short responses, successful parsed function calls >= 99% in test harness.
Quote: "If we can get streaming + tool-calls stable, we convert our support channel and save ~2 FTEs" - Samir.

Action items: SE to reproduce deterministic failure and collect raw streams (RDW-8732); AE to schedule POC kickoff and attach sample prompts + function schema to Drive; Ask infra: provide brief on batching/kv-cache settings that may affect streaming truncation; Create test harness that validates function schema keys strictly and surfaces mismatch examples.
Next steps agreed: POC kickoff meeting, SE will attempt to reproduce with Redwood hosted_api and share a small corpus of failed streams for engineering triage.
